evidence: Rendered desktop DOM inspected with Playwright. Counts include hidden tab panels and carousel slides, not just the visible viewport.
copyright_status: Structure and original descriptions only; source prose and media are not reproduced.

sections.name: Global navigation
sections.structure: Brand navigation; product, language and hub menus; direct links; overflow and global Microsoft menus; search.
sections.migration_requirement: Preserve every menu destination. External destinations and excluded product areas remain links rather than local pages. Rebuild responsive navigation and keyboard interaction.

sections.name: Announcement strip
sections.structure: Dismissible campaign notice with an image and outbound action.
sections.migration_requirement: Record the active campaign and dismissal behavior. Do not silently omit campaign content.

sections.name: Opening introduction
sections.structure: Page identity, primary heading, introductory content and one illustration.
sections.migration_requirement: Obtain approved copy and illustration; preserve the initial layout before redesign.

sections.name: Product explorer
sections.structure: Five product tabs, fifteen image elements and fifteen links across all panels.
sections.migration_requirement: Migrate every tab, not only the default Azure panel. Groups cover Azure, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Visual Studio and Windows.

sections.name: Campaign carousel
sections.structure: Five slides, six image elements and previous/next controls.
sections.migration_requirement: Capture every slide and action. Preserve accessible carousel navigation and skip links.

sections.name: News carousel
sections.structure: Three article slides plus a changelog route.
sections.migration_requirement: Keep article metadata separate from the carousel template. External articles stay outbound.

sections.name: Programming-language destinations
sections.structure: Six icon links, mixing same-host language pages and external sites.
sections.migration_requirement: Preserve the full set of links; migrate only same-host destination pages.

sections.name: Community carousel
sections.structure: Eight community slides linking to internal and external programs.
sections.migration_requirement: Include Azure Tech Groups, advocates and Reactor in discovery; do not reduce to the currently visible cards.

sections.name: Developer hub cards
sections.structure: Three illustrated destinations for AI, APIs and games.
sections.migration_requirement: Include AI and API hub routes. Keep the games link but exclude the games destination from recreation, per user direction.

sections.name: Developer profile feature
sections.structure: Editorial story region with two image elements and two links.
sections.migration_requirement: Obtain the approved story copy and media. Preserve external story destinations as links.

sections.name: Blog feature
sections.structure: Featured article area with four image elements and five links.
sections.migration_requirement: Keep this region on the included homepage, but do not recreate blog destination pages. The user excluded the Microsoft Developer blog; other editorial hosts are already out of scope.

sections.name: Event carousel
sections.structure: Five event slides, previous/next controls and a community-events link.
sections.migration_requirement: Record event dates, expiry and registration dependencies from an authorized content export.

sections.name: Newsletter call to action
sections.structure: One image and a subscription destination.
sections.migration_requirement: Keep the existing destination; do not submit subscriptions or fabricate a working local signup service.

sections.name: Learning explorer
sections.structure: Five topic tabs, twenty image elements and twenty-five links across all panels.
sections.migration_requirement: Keep all topic panels: AI, Azure, Copilot, DevOps and Security. Learning content on other hosts is not migrated.

sections.name: Social destinations
sections.migration_requirement: Preserve destinations without crawling external social sites.

sections.name: Footer and preferences
sections.structure: Locale destination, legal links, cookie-management control and a theme selector.
sections.migration_requirement: Rebuild local theme behavior. Define preview-safe consent behavior and keep third-party analytics disabled.
